title: Scenario 3 knowledge check
notes: PROVISIONAL INSTRUMENT. These items were drafted for the FarmSim prototype and have NOT been reviewed or approved by a supervisor. Review and revise before any study use. Editing this file is enough to change the instrument - no code changes are required.

questions.text: During the drought the reserve was shared. What did that mean in practice?
options: Each player had a private reserve
Every litre one player used was a litre the other could not use
Water refilled whenever it ran out
Only one player could carry water
questions.explanation: There was one reserve for the whole farm, so watering was a joint decision rather than two separate ones.

questions.text: With the reserve running low and more field than water, what generally protects the most yield?
options: Give every tile a small amount
Keep a smaller number of tiles properly watered
Save the water and use none of it
Water only the tiles furthest from the well
questions.explanation: Water spread too thinly leaves everything stressed. Fewer tiles kept out of stress usually harvest better than a whole field kept just below it.

questions.text: Tiles that spent a long time dry finished the season with a lower yield even after being watered again. Why?
options: The watering came from the wrong player
Condition lost during the dry period is not fully recovered later
questions.explanation: Once a crop has lost condition it does not fully recover, so avoiding the stress is worth more than repairing it afterwards.
